strings.Bridges and buildings: load paths, const: Gadoji da gine-gine: hanyoyin ɗaukar nauyi, gini da tabbatarwa.
strings.Each course has 5 stages and 40 steps: l: Kowane kwas yana da zangoni 5 da matakai 40: nauyi da tsarin ɗaukar nauyi, kayayyaki da mahaɗai, gini da sarrafa zangoni, gwaji da sa ido, dorewa da miƙawa; kowane darasi an raba shi zuwa hanyar ɗaukar nauyi, lissafi, tabbatarwa da gano musabbabin lalacewa. Daga Gadar Akashi Kaikyō da Gadar Millau zuwa Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa da Gidan Opera na Sydney, tare da muhimman alkaluma, jadawalin lokaci, ƙa'idojin gini da kwatanta fitattun ayyuka. Sashe na farko na kowane kwas kyauta ne.
